sys.path.insert(0,str(source))
from benchmark_tools.prepare_ob_candidate_neighborhood import check,record
from benchmark_tools.run_membership_hillclimb import write_json
from benchmark_tools.report_hillclimb import ENDPOINTS,screen
base=repo/"benchmark_tools/results"
parent_path=base/"hillclimb_comparison_readback_v6_20261013/summary.json"
compact_path=base/"copy_branch_qfo_partial_readback_compact_v1_20261013.json"
parent=json.loads(parent_path.read_text());compact=json.loads(compact_path.read_text())
check(compact["full_local_readback"])
full=json.loads(Path(compact["full_local_readback"]["path"]).read_text())
out=base/"hillclimb_comparison_readback_v7_20261013";assert not out.exists()
out.mkdir()
methods=parent["methods"]
old_method_states={m["key"]:json.dumps(m,sort_keys=True) for m in methods}
replacement={}
for c in full["cells"]:
    key=c["method_key"]
    assert key.startswith("copy_branch:")
    slim={k:v for k,v in c.items() if k!="checked"}
    slim["checked_records_storage"]={"full_local_readback":compact["full_local_readback"],"method_key":key,"records":len(c.get("checked",[]))}
    method=next(m for m in methods if m["key"]==key)
    positions=[i for i,old in enumerate(method["cells"]) if old["dataset"]=="QfO"]
    assert len(positions)==1
    old=method["cells"][positions[0]]
    if old["status"]=="independent_content_readback_verified":
        assert old["scores"]==slim["scores"] and old["products"]==slim["products"]
    method["cells"][positions[0]]=slim
    if slim["status"]=="independent_content_readback_verified": method["scores"].update(slim["scores"])
    method["complete_eight_endpoints"]=set(method["scores"])==set(ENDPOINTS)
    replacement[key]={"prior_status":old["status"],"captured_status":slim["status"]}
for m in methods:
    if not m["key"].startswith("copy_branch:"): assert json.dumps(m,sort_keys=True)==old_method_states[m["key"]]
screening=dict(parent["round_screening"])
vectors={m["key"].split(":",1)[1]:m["scores"] for m in methods if m["key"].startswith("copy_branch:")}
screening["copy_branch"]=screen(vectors,"control")
assert screening["copy_branch"]["comparisons"]["large_only500"]["complete_eight_endpoint_contrast"]
assert not screening["copy_branch"]["comparisons"]["large_only500"]["passes_point_estimate_screen"]
assert not screening["copy_branch"]["comparisons"]["medium_only500"]["complete_eight_endpoint_contrast"]
with (out/"scores.tsv").open("x") as stream:
    writer=csv.writer(stream,delimiter="\t");writer.writerow(["method",*ENDPOINTS,"complete_eight_endpoints"])
    for m in methods: writer.writerow([m["label"],*(m["scores"].get(k,"NA") for k in ENDPOINTS),set(m["scores"])==set(ENDPOINTS)])
with (out/"scores.tsv").open() as stream: rows=list(csv.DictReader(stream,delimiter="\t"))
assert len(rows)==len(methods)==22
for row,m in zip(rows,methods):
    assert row["method"]==m["label"]
